name: The Smoosh
description: Two smashed beef patties, melted American cheese, grilled onions, pickles, and Smoosh sauce on a toasted bun.

name: The Double Smoosh
description: A bigger version of the original Smoosh with extra smashed beef, extra cheese, grilled onions, pickles, and Smoosh sauce.

name: The Spicy Smoosh
description: Two smashed beef patties, cheese, grilled onions, pickles, spicy peppers, and a hotter version of Smoosh sauce.

name: The Crawler
description: A Smoosh-style loaded hot dog served on a toasted bun and finished with toppings worthy of The Crawler name.

name: Smoosh Fries
description: Golden, crispy, seasoned fries served hot and fresh. The perfect sidekick to any Smoosh burger or dog.

name: Loaded Smoosh Fries
description: Crispy fries topped with melted cheese, bacon, and Smoosh sauce for a richer, more indulgent side.

name: Canned Drinks
description: An ice-cold drink to go with your Smoosh meal. Choose from Coke, Diet Coke, Dr Pepper, Sprite, or bottled water.
